purpose: Confirm whether the synthetic pilot’s representation ordering replicates on the complete deterministic Fourier-noise dataset.

primary_replication.name: clean_condition_ten_seed_replication
primary_replication.claim_tested: On the original clean synthetic setting, Fourier features and inferred jump descriptors reproduce the relative ordering reported in the pilot manuscript.

robustness_extension.name: noise_condition_evaluation
robustness_extension.description: Evaluate the model selected by the primary protocol separately on the five held-out noise strata without altering the frozen training data or model-selection rule.

statistical_reporting.replication_rule: A pilot ordering is treated as replicated only when the complete clean-condition ten-seed result has the same directional ordering and its corresponding paired comparison is documented without post-hoc hyperparameter changes.

integrity_rules: Use only the frozen train, validation, and test files from the complete dataset.
Do not select hyperparameters using test metrics.
Retain per-seed records, predictions, confusion matrices, command manifest, environment record, and checksums.
Treat the paper’s three-seed pilot as historical evidence; do not overwrite it with the confirmatory result.
